lines.text: An eagle looms over the house of the LORD because the people rebelled against His law, and an enemy will pursue Israel.
Israel sets up kings without God's approval and makes idols for itself from its silver and gold.
A craftsman made the calf of Samaria, and Israel sows the wind and reaps the whirlwind.
Israel is swallowed up among the nations, and has gone up to Babylon like a wild donkey on its own.
God does not accept their sacrifices and says they will return to Edom, and He will send fire upon their cities.
